method.assessment: Require 0.30 temporal intersection over union and 50% recall of the labeled edit. Count gains, losses, incorrect refinements, ordinary refinements, and unchanged dispositions. The latest speaker-disjoint confirmation shares editor lineage and background sources with earlier work.
method.cases: Three previously scored banks for retrospective comparison. For additional confirmation take one new publisher-labeled 0.20–1.00 s cut-and-paste edit per previously unused SINE reader from three pinned archive prefixes. Retain one six-second original/edit pair per reader. Match each pair clean and at −5 dB with previously used AMI rooms.
method.choose: Keep the existing five-window review point. Consider only one-second windows wholly contained in the already flagged two-second range. Each normalization route must exceed its own earlier development point. The agreement route changes the displayed range only if both routes choose the same interval. Otherwise retain the broad range. No route creates an additional file flag.
